subject.title: test(browser): replace broad win32 skip with dynamic directory symlink check

question: Is terminal proof for this test-only Windows-gating change enough, or should the PR wait for native Windows focused output before merge?
rationale: The code path is clean and mirrors a merged sibling pattern, but the changed behavior is specifically Windows test execution and the posted proof does not show native Windows execution.

options.title: Merge After Green Checks
options.body: Accept the low test-harness risk once required checks are green because the current head matches the sibling accepted pattern and has no blocking code finding.

options.title: Request Native Windows Proof
options.body: Ask for a native Windows run of `extensions/browser/src/browser/output-directories.test.ts` showing the symlink case executes with junction support rather than skipping.

options.title: Hold For CI
options.body: Leave the PR open but unmerged until the unrelated lint failure is cleared or confirmed as main-side noise.
